publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.25 documents how to export a hosted D1 backup from the deploying checkout using its Wrangler and the Node runtime supplied by the one-line installer. New hosted public HTTP monitors with default TLS and no runner-local credentials select the Cloudflare Worker by default. The private runner remains selectable. Long installation names wrap in the mobile Monitors area and editor, leaving room for Sign out. The @runeditrun/rer pin moves to 0.2.131, which serves retryable 503 responses while the local runtime is starting and reports premature owner sign-in browser exits promptly. The local guides and Run page describe first-start timing and progress every 20 seconds. All 91 SQL migrations from 0.5.24 are byte-identical, with zero new migrations or required settings. Existing monitors, history, incidents, destinations, and private settings are retained. Before upgrading, use Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup if applicable. For a CLI backup, verify the native session while dev is running, stop dev, and use the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE to run rer export --output exports/uptime.rer within five minutes. Keep the cookie private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Stop dev or preview before deploying, keep the deployment receipt, and use the existing installation keys. The mail configuration guidance and known limits in the changelog still apply. Product screenshot available from 0.4.0 at .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png. — Run Edit Run fleet, 2026-11-22.
